title: Hinomori Shiho — Card Story

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's so nice and quiet since nobody's here at this time.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Now then... Ah, I just got a notification.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's time to feed them and clean their room.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Is everyone doing well?
Ugh, the room is in a mess again.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Ah. One just came over.
It moves just like a real bunny, and that's so cute...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Here's your food...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey...don't snatch.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now to clean up the room and...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can't forget to brush them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They're so happy. Hehe.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I could look after real bunnies if I joined the caretaker committee, but...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That would definitely interfere with my part-time job, so I'll just have to make do with this for now...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ah, Shiho!
There you are!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Kuh?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?
Did you just, uh, hide something behind you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hm? Where's that beeping sound coming from?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I forgot to mute it... But if I close the app while I'm still caring for the animals, their affection level will drop...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It's probably just your imagination!
I don't hear anything at all?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shiho, you're talking really loudly today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is my normal volume. What do you want, anyway?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right! I'm here to tell you that our math and art classes have switched for today, so we'll be having art class first later.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thought you should know since we have to change classrooms!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(She looked all over for me just to tell me that?
She's really kind to a fault...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Is that all?
I got it, so you can go back now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay. See you later!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sigh.
Thank goodness she didn't notice what I was doing...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, everyone, I'll finish cleaning your room now—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Aww, is that a bunny pet game? They're so cute!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wha?! Why are you still?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha... Sorry. I forgot to tell you that we'll need to bring along our picture textbook for art class later...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Fine, I got it.
I really do, so can you just please go back already—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The beeping sound just now was from this game, right? How are you supposed to care for these bunnies?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I play pet games sometimes too, but I don't think I've ever seen this bunny app before!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Just normal stuff.
Like feeding them, brushing them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you pet them like this, they may react to it... Ah!

rows.Speaker: Shiho & Minori
rows.Line: So cute!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Did you see that?! The bunny's ears were bobbing!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. That's unusual because they don't do that often...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Ah!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe, I didn't know you could make a face like that too♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What're you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Break time's over. I'm heading back to class now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, wait for me, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sigh.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ah... G-Good morning, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Morning.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Um...
Is that a guitar case on your back?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That's a question I would expect Minori to ask, not her...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
U-Um...
D-Do you know how to play the guitar, Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not the acoustic. This is a bass guitar.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, a bass guitar... I can tell you really treasure it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What makes you say that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Well, you set it down so gently just now, and in a place without too much human traffic... That's because you don't want people to accidentally kick it, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm. You're very observant.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You can't perform well if you don't value your instrument.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm sorry?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Something a bassist that I look up to once said.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This bass is a model used by that bassist too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Ah! Okay.
Hehe, you must really look up to that bassist.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You could say that again.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I... I recently made a new friend.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Her father is a very well-respected person among musicians and music-lovers in the area.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wow, he sounds amazing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. It's really nice to have someone like that around you. It encourages you somehow.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This person who's well-respected among musicians, does he perform in live shows?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Not anymore, but he was doing that a while ago.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right now, he's running a shop known as Weekend Garage.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What... As in the live show cafe?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You know about it?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. It's not the genre I'm into, but that cafe's pretty well-known around here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I didn't know it was such a famous shop!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It is. Wait a minute...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If that's your friend's father... That means your friend is the girl with amazing singing skills that everyone's been talking about?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Are you talking about An?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I don't know what everyone's saying about her, but yes, she's a great singer. I sing together with her, and she teaches me sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What? You sing together?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You actually visit that shop, Kohane?
And practice singing with that girl?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Um... Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wh-What?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, just thinking about how you get so much more chatty when talking about anything music-related.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is that bad?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, not at all. It makes me happy.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'll answer your questions in order.
I visit the shop about three to four times every week, and...
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're done with the warm-up.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What would you like to do now?
Practice other songs until Ichika and Saki get here?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nah, I'd rather go over the one we just did again.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: When we played it with everyone last time, there was something off about my bass and your drums.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ah, I noticed that too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll set the metronome.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay. Which part do you want to start with?
The one I felt was most off was...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Bar 16, right? Can we start a little earlier, from bar 12?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, sure. Whenever you're ready.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'll do the count in.
One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Phew. I think we ironed out the kinks.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Next time we play with everyone, it's going to be flawless.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I'm glad we got it worked out.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: By the way, I spoke with Shizuku the other day.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What did she want?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She asked about you, how you're liking playing in the band.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I told her you were enjoying it.
She seemed relieved.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Shizuku worried about me when I stopped hanging out with Honami, Saki, and Ichika...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, and she also asked me if she could see one of our rehearsals.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You've got to be kidding me...
She wants to come and watch us?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, yeah, but she said I could also just record it for her.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank the stars for that.
I wouldn't be able to focus on playing with her here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hmm?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think she just cares a lot about you, you know?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Honami, you never change...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I know she does.
Is that why you brought this up?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes... I'm sorry, that was uncalled for, wasn't it?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's alright. You're just being you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Honami's always trying to see things from other people's perspectives, wanting to help everyone.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She gets misunderstood because of that, like happened earlier with her classmates, but she can't help it.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I think it's admirable.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll try to give Shizuku more attention when I get home.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You will? That's great!
I'm sure that'll make her happy!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Classic Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nothing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika and Saki will be here soon. Let's wrap this up.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're going to surprise them with how perfectly locked in we're now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Okay, let's play it one last time.
Live House

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Thanks for your help with the bass, Shiho.
You saved the show once again.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't worry about it. It's good practice for me anyhow.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I heard you formed a band with your school friends. That so?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh... Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Hmm. You've turned down every single band invite before. Why the sudden change of heart?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *shrugs*

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It wasn't such a big deal. I've known the other girls since we were little, so I thought we'd easily get along in a band.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Makes sense.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
You stoked my curiosity though.
I'd like to hear you guys live. Why don't you play here?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: For real?!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, we'd be playing on a real stage, to check our setup in a real setting?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Isn't that like a huge chance for us?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even if we play before the venue opens to customers, without an audience, that's still us playing in a live house!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's just going to be a few songs, nothing like a gig.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, performing in a live house is going to be so exciting!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! We're doing this, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you're all up for it, I'll let my boss know later today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks sooo much, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let go! Don't get clingy, I get enough of that from my sister!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Come on, you're excited too. Admit it! You're going to speak with your boss, even though you're not working today, huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Uh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, it's your day off?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. You can't fool Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I just wanted to get it out of the way.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, you've played on real stages before, right? What's it like?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd like to know that too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You can find out for yourselves soon enough.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Boo! I'll be on edge all the time until then! I hope I don't get too stressed to play well.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You'll be fine, just keep practicing as usual.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I guess you're right. No need to get so antsy!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But it will be different from what we're used to... I'm worried it may be so overwhelming for me that I'll miss a beat...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Don't sweat it, Honami.
You're a seasoned brass band performer, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I've never played in an actual music venue before...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm feeling a little anxious too, but I'm also excited for it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Same! It's so cool that Shiho's boss is letting us, total noobs, use his stage! It's like Christmas came early!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I earned that favor with my hard work. Gimme some praise.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Haha. You're amazing, Shiho!
I'll treat you to bubble tea!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The only thing I can offer you is a yakisoba bun...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I have some candy!
Here!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I was kidding.
Cut it out, you don't owe me nothing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Speaking of bubble tea, I could go for some right now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Want to go get some? Let's move over to a cafe, relax over our bubble tea, and have Shiho tell us more about that live house.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sounds like a plan!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hehe, okay.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But we're going to rehearse after that, okay?
We can't embarrass ourselves in front of my boss.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're going hardcore with our practice until everything's perfect, and I don't want to hear any complaints, alright?
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Our jam session that day...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sigh...
Honami, count us in.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
O-Okay. Here it goes...
One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Ichika, Saki, and Honami can play their instruments to an extent, but...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Everyone played at their own pace, so our tempo was completely off. That wasn't a jam session at all.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Well, the last time we played as a band together was so many years ago. We haven't even spoken much in the last year. There was just no way we'd be in sync.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It was such a terrible session...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I can't forget the music we made together that day...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I wonder why?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Good morning, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Morning...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Morning!
Hey, there's something we wanted to show you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't bother.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?! At least a glance!
Just a single glance will do!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sigh...
What is it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah! Okay, here... Hm?
Um, where'd I put that thing?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think you folded it up and put it in your pocket. Oh, not that pocket... Yes, that one.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Most of my classmates don't even bother trying to talk to me.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Except these two. They talk to me like it's only natural, and greet me in the morning and before leaving school.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But they're not trying to meddle with me because I'm always alone or anything...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It feels like...they just really want to talk to me.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Just like Saki in the past.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'd tell her I wanted to play my games or be alone but she'd ask me to show her the game or play together. She just wouldn't leave me alone.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She was really persistent back then...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Minori and Kohane are quite normal compared to her.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Found it! Here you go, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A flyer?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes. They were giving it out at the station.
I think some rock bands in this town are gathering for an event.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
This is the part we wanted to show you!
You see? There are a few girl bands taking part too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay. And?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And... I've never gone to a live show of a rock band before.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too. I visit live music clubs sometimes, but I've never been to a rock show before, so...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Why are they looking at me like that...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sigh...
What exactly do you want me to do?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um! We want you to come to the show with us!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, yes...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I thought so...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, it's not like I'm not interested in this event...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?! Thanks, Shiho!
We were a little apprehensive about going if it was just the two of us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, thank you, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait... Hang on, I didn't say I was going—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, let's decide on a time to meet!
Let's see... The venue opens at 5:00 PM, so...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They'll be selling merchandise too, so it may be better for us to go earlier. What do you think, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They even have a one-track mind like her...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nothing.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Where should I have my lunch?
Since the weather's pretty good today, the rooftop will probably be too crowded...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Hm? Isn't that...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And also... We practiced the rhythm section parts together the other day!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's just wonderful... Oh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My dearest Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You don't have to shout, I can hear you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello, Shiho! Going for lunch?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes. You?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Same. But I have a club meeting to attend, so I'll be having lunch in the home economics room.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh dear, I didn't know you had to be somewhere. I'm sorry for holding you back, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's okay! Well, I really have to go now.
See you after school, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm going to have my lunch now too, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ugh...
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, it's been such a long time since we've had the chance to eat lunch together by ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, whatever...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, you're too close. I can't eat like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Mhm...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Are you listening to me?
We're already in high school. Stop being so clingy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry. It's just... I'm so happy.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: About eating lunch together?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, it's not that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You started a band with Honami, Ichika, and Saki, right? That's what I'm happy about.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've been so worried ever since Saki was hospitalized.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Ichika and Honami suddenly stopped coming over to play. I really thought something had happened.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And you sometimes come home from school looking so upset.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You seldom talk to me about what's going on in your life, so...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So I'm happy to see the four of you getting along so well again, like you used to.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But...what about you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Your work and group members.
I know you were stressed, but you didn't say anything about it, either...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I even had to find out that you'd quit from the news...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You see? You don't talk to me about the important stuff, either.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Whoa, wh-what?!
Don't hug me all of a sudden like that!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I had no idea you cared so much about me!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I-I told you to stop being so clingy!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I love you, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Fine! I get it!
So just listen to me for a minute!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hello, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're the first. Thinking of doing some self-practice?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, and...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks...for your concern about Saki.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It's no problem at all.
I only mentioned it because I was a little worried, too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I didn't take your advice in the end, and that's why Saki...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know it's a little too late to be asking, but I really want to make sure this is the last time it happens.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So please, tell me how you knew Saki wasn't feeling well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You... Well, all of you are such devoted friends.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But the truth is, I don't think I'll be very helpful.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sure it was only by coincidence that I noticed.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Coincidence?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Saki was trying really hard to hide the fact that she wasn't feeling well from all of you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Because of that, she wasn't paying much attention to how she was behaving around Miku and myself.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And that's why you noticed...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes.
You don't sound very convinced, though?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, that's not it...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You really care very deeply about Saki.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In the same way, I'm sure Saki cares very deeply about you, Ichika, and Honami as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's why she tried to hide her ill health.
She didn't want to lose any precious time at all.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, because she truly values the time she can spend with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sure that's how she was able to conquer her illness too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She would always put on a bright smile for us, even though she must've been in so much pain.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki is really strong.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Admittedly, though, that strength of hers can become a cause for concern sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, like the way she overexerted herself this time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I wish she would trust us more.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She's quick to agree to almost every weird suggestion any of us makes...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But hesitates to tell us the really important things.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I must say, I feel like I've gotten to know Saki a little better after this episode.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I know what you mean.
That's not going to be enough to help put Shiho's mind at ease about Saki, though.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If you don't mind, I hope you can continue to keep an eye on her for just a little while more.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, I fully intend on doing just that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you for everything, Luka and Miku.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Miku, Luka, hello! Huh?
Shiho's here too?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're really early.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh dear, I hope we didn't interrupt your conversation?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No. We were almost done talking anyway.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nrgh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wh-What is it?
Stop staring at me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Are you hiding something from us, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: N-No, I'm not...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No way! You were definitely sharing secrets with them!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I already said, I'm not hiding anything.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Fine, then. I'll just ask Luka and Miku about it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, w-wait a minute!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The way she reacted...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Saki guessed correctly, then.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's not too late for you to confess, yet!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure, whatever! Anyway, we should be practicing! Let's start practicing!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What? Wait for me, Shiho!
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Stop.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika, you're too fast. Pay closer attention to the sounds around you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I am? I'm sorry, I didn't notice at all.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It started about two bars before the hook.
Be careful.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that's the part I'm not too sure about, too...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I didn't notice anything about your performance just now, but—

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah, right! Don't play something without confidence, right? I'll make it work!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Good. Ichika, can you do it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um... Can we lower the tempo slightly for now?
I want to know where I went wrong.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In that case, we should start from the top of the verse instead.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
All right. Let's go, then.
One, two, three, four!
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika was having a really tough time before the chorus.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes. There's a key change there, and it was already a difficult chord to begin with.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But if she focuses too much on the sound, she may lose the momentum and sharpness she currently has.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Actually, I wanted to discuss that with you.
Is there anything we can do instead?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. The rhythm section has to step up at times like these.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I can try adjusting my method of drumming, if that will do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Or I can make each beat louder so she can hear better.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. It may be easier for Ichika to play her guitar if we change the way she listens to the other sounds.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Nothing. It's just that you seem so happy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Anyway, you have to go to your part-time job now, right? Good luck and see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. See you tomorrow.
Live House

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Clean up is done.
Now to take stock of the equipment—

rows.Speaker: Guitarist
rows.Line: Found you! Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, hello. Long time no see.
Do you need help with your performance today too?

rows.Speaker: Guitarist
rows.Line: No, I'm just here to talk because the owner said you finally joined a band!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I didn't really join a band...
More like I formed a band with four of my childhood friends.

rows.Speaker: Guitarist
rows.Line: Childhood friends? Girls? Boys?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? All girls, why?

rows.Speaker: Guitarist
rows.Line:
So a girl band like mine! I see...
The lone wolf Shiho finally has a band to call home too, huh?

rows.Speaker: Guitarist
rows.Line: Hehe. Your aura has changed somewhat recently too. And your performance.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What? I haven't change the way I perform, though.

rows.Speaker: Guitarist
rows.Line: Really? Well, do you remember the time about a month ago when I asked you to help with our performance?

rows.Speaker: Guitarist
rows.Line: Back then, it felt like you were trying to pull us together by using sheer technique and sharp playing to cover over our quirks and mistakes.

rows.Speaker: Guitarist
rows.Line: But a short while ago, when you helped again, it felt more like you were trying to bring out the best in us by using your skills to enhance our deficiencies and quirks.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...really?

rows.Speaker: Guitarist
rows.Line: Yup. Wish we could have you in our band, but you wouldn't have found that style of performing with us, right?

rows.Speaker: Guitarist
rows.Line: You have some great friends, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes. We're not quite anything like an actual band yet, but it's really fun to play together with them.

rows.Speaker: Guitarist
rows.Line: I agree! Nothing beats performing together with the people you can have the most fun with!

rows.Speaker: Guitarist
rows.Line: By the way, do you already have a name for your band?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes. We adapted it from the Leonids meteor shower that we saw together a long time ago.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Leo/need. That's the name of our band.
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Shall we try rehearsing as a group now?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Honami, count us in.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh! I-I'm so sorry.
I just spaced out for a second...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Honami's not really focused on practice.
It's probably because of the choir recital...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So your class had a bit of a fight over that?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I understand the feelings of both the people who want to do their best and those who don't have the time to spend on this event...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Here we go!
One, two, three, four!
song00003_off_f

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Gasp...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry! I skipped over that part...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's okay. I didn't get a good start there either. Let's do it again!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay...
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I won't be able to practice on my own once recital practices start. And I'm making careless mistakes as a result in SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: One more time...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (No, the same spot again...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sigh... This might just make things worse...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I should just pack up for today... I won't be making any progress unless I reboot my mind first.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Aha!
I thought I heard a bass guitar!
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Perfect timing. Want to have a session together?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sorry but I was actually just about to head back...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Is something wrong?
You seemed a little distracted just now...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know! It's about Honami, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: How did you...?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Actually, Honami told me about the trouble she was having in class because of the choir recital.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She couldn't find the solution even after talking to you and felt bad about troubling everyone with her problems.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's why you're worried about her, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's half of it, I guess...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What's the other half?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: When she first told us about her situation, the way I spoke to her was a little... No, I was pretty harsh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Harsh? As in...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're worried because you're afraid, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're afraid of being disliked by the people on whichever side you don't pick, no?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't regret what I said... Only the way I said it...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I couldn't be there for her when she was going through that rough patch in junior high because I'd silently distanced myself.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But things are different now. Honami's gotten comfortable enough with us to share her worries.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And I just really wanted to actually help her out this time. But I messed up...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Why I can't say things in a nicer way?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You'll be fine, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm sure Honami understood,
what you were trying to say.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And that it was your special way of showing concern for her.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So there's no need for you to be so hard on yourself.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, also... I was supposed to keep the fact that Honami came to talk to me about the choir recital a secret, so don't tell her I told you, okay?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She might get mad if she were to find out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hehe. You know she wouldn't get angry like that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry for holding you back.
Let's play together at another time, okay?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Bye then!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you, MEIKO...
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Phew. The choir recital is finally over.
Now we can all focus on band practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We'll need to have a discussion once everyone gets here...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're worried because you're afraid, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're afraid of being disliked by the people on whichever side you don't pick, no?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (MEIKO reassured me that Honami understood what I was trying to say but...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sigh... I probably should at least apologize to her.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami... Sorry, I didn't notice you there at all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's okay, I just arrived.
May I sit with you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, of course...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I hope she didn't hear me talking to myself just now...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, you know...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Y-Yes...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think you're really cool.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So you don't have to apologize for anything.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(She did hear me...
But...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't want things to end like this, so I have to say it...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Honami...
For not being able to tell you in a nicer way.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Shiho...
It's okay. Don't worry about it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks... But I really want to be careful with what I say from now on.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. See? You're so cool.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You didn't have to apologize at all, you know.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It was your words that ultimately spurred me on to try harder in the end.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I also know you tend to sound harsh because you're usually the one who courageously speaks up about things that others have a hard time saying.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You always seem unconcerned, but you always point out the things we need to pay attention to when it matters...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: People find it hard to accept sometimes and I'm sure that causes a lot of pain for you as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But you wouldn't have said anything at all if you truly didn't care.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thanks to your words, I was able to overcome my weakness.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then I'm glad it turned out well...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've realized something because of all this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really? What?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You really need a lot of courage to express your opinion and stand by it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course, you'll still wonder if what you're saying is correct or that the other person may not understand what you're trying to say.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And there's also a real possibility that people may end up hating you because of that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... I know it's strange for me to be saying all this now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But you've always been so clear about what you wanted ever since we were little.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And that's why I think you're so cool!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: However, I don't think it's appropriate for me to just blurt out whatever comes to mind.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, um... I may still end up sounding a little harsh, but I'm gonna try to tone it down for sure.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I really love that part of you, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hah. Who are you, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, Saki and Ichika are late. Shall we start eating without them?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm famished...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Shiho & Honami
rows.Line: Let's eat!
Lunch Break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Campus

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Playing in a band as a hobby and doing it professionally are completely different things. You won't make it as a pro unless you absolutely commit to it.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Which is why I don't want bandmates who're only playing for fun and don't have the resolve to really take it seriously.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(They're serious about becoming professionals.
Making a living through music.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Going pro, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(My dad and his friends were professionals.
I grew up listening to his band's albums...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They had so many powerful, stirring songs I couldn't get enough of...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Not just them either. That girl band really opened up my eyes to how awesome the bass can be...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They're playing professionally now and still making strides with their music.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'd be lying if I said I didn't care about becoming a pro. I want to see just how far I can go.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (My idea of getting better is different from everyone else's...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What am I supposed to do...?
Shii...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I knew it was you!
I saw you walking all alone,
so I had to run right over!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're not with your friends today?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Nah. They hang out with their classmates too.
It's not like we have lunch together every day.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Shii...
You've seemed so down lately.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What's bugging you? Something to do with your band?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
How did you...?
It's like you can read my mind...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because you're my dearest little sister!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii, can I tell you something...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wh-Why are you in my personal space...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. We're about to have a heart-to-heart talk.
I think the closer the better for that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Ugh... She won't stop clinging to me, no matter what I say...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, what did you want to talk about?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. It's about seriously deciding to try to make it as an independent idol group with Airi, Haruka and Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
And...?
Is that all...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I already heard about that from Minori...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, of course you did.
I keep forgetting you're classmates.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But anyway, I wanted to tell you about it myself.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was worried that my fans would stop supporting me if I strayed from my Cheerful * Days persona.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But you know what? I want them to get to know me not as the Shizuku Hinomori that my old producers wanted, but as myself.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was scared of how my fans would react, but I decided to follow through with this anyway...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I wouldn't have had the courage to do so if it wasn't for Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She said that she likes me for who I am now, which gave me that last push I needed to make up my mind.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She made all the difference, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She did.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It may seem strange coming from me, but I think you should talk it out with Honami and the others if you can.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure they'll understand if you decide to be honest with them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Shizuku...
Are you secretly a psychic or something?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. No, but I know you better than you do yourself!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, that's even scarier...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But, um... Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Don't worry about it. I'm just doing my job as your big sister!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hold on, why are you trying to creep in even closer...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm just so happy we could talk so much today!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Sometimes I wonder if she really is the older one...
But I think I'll let that slide for today...)
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, that should be good for today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay. But sorry about this, everyone.
I appreciate you all sticking around for this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Don't worry about it! I wanted to work on my part some more as well, so it wasn't all just you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, same here! And I also like seeing how gung-ho you've been for band stuff lately, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really? I guess I wanted to put Nene's singing tips into practice more than I realized.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks to her, I feel like I'm getting closer to singing the way I've been imagining that I could.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Totally! I mean today...
You were GLORIOUS! Right, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Morning...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho! Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hi, Shiho! We were just talking about MORE MORE JUMP!'s stream from yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ah, that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait... Did you watch it too, Shiho?!
Please tell me what you thought! Pretty please!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure! Where to start...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Minori looks like she's been having a lot of fun lately. Almost as much as Saki when she's really riding high.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And she's freelancing as an idol on top of that. I don't know anything about idols but that has to be hard work.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks, Kohane!
I really appreciate your feedback!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right! Do you have any suggestions or requests for our next video?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If you're taking requests, I'd love to see a video where you share tips for getting better at singing, or talk about what you do for vocal training!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Kohane's changed too...
And I don't just mean her hairstyle either...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She said that she and her friends are working towards the same goal now...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You formed a group with some students from Kamiyama, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's right! They're amazing singers and have way more experience than me. That's why I have to work twice as hard to catch up to them!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But she seems like she's enjoying it...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(If you really set your mind on something,
I guess it can be fun, even if it's difficult.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's like Ichika and these two have this sparkle to them...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And what am I doing with my life...? I'm at a crossroads and don't know which way to go...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(I didn't use to be like that...
Before Saki returned from the hospital,
these choices came easily to me...)
—! Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Saki...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Are you okay?
You look like a deflated balloon...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! That was when you were really into Miku, right, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You were even humming some Miku songs while you put your collage together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Come to think of it, you recommended us a lot of Miku songs back then. You were so desperate about getting us to listen to them too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I remember that too. It was so cute.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: S-Stop, please, I feel really embarrassed.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: However, Honami, I still remember exactly what you made...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh? Me?
What did I make...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You made Shibao, remember?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki and Ichika were so confused by your initial sketch too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, we totally were! Ichi even thought that Shibao was an octopus at first...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it was also really cool how it clearly became a puppy in the end!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That was pretty interesting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-It was...?
I recall that it turned out okay but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And Shiho just sat there really silently while she made hers... It was a band playing a show, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, it was so incredible how detailed Shiho's was.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think that was just about the time my dad started taking me to live houses...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Those shows are still fresh in my head too. That's probably what I was trying to recreate...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I sort of bit off more than I could chew and ended up with just the band on stage.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Still, your attention to detail was like your way of putting your signature on it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. You were so focused that you didn't even look our way when we tried calling your name.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't remember that happening...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Nostalgia really is a powerful thing, isn't it? Especially when it comes to our childhood memories.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, wanna head over to SEKAI and go through some pictures from back then?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll bring some field trip and moon viewing albums!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That sounds nice. How about after practice, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Fine...
But no slacking off during practice, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, time to hunt down those albums♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to see them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Me too.
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, shall we get started on our moon viewing dango?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay! Which do you wanna have first, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Soy glaze, soybean powder, red bean paste... There's even soy sauce and... Sesame seed paste?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's more now compared to during your stream...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hm? Did you say something?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Uh, no. Ignore that.
Still, there are so many toppings.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Airi made all of these.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, she's a really amazing cook!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
What's this one?
It's brown and looks charred.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that's Airi's special miso dango!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Miso dango?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you make it by putting miso on some dango, roasting it and wrapping it in seaweed.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori was so excited when she got a whiff of what Airi was making too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it's a shame that we couldn't show everyone that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! No, that would be so embarrassing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Anyway, I thought they turned out pretty well, so I hope you try some.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you.
In that case, I'll take one.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, Shii, is it good?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Um... Why are you inching closer towards me, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because I'm just so happy that we get to do a moon viewing party like this, Shii♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I get that you're excited, but you're also sort of acting like a little kid...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I totally understand how you feel, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm really happy about being able to have a party with Shiho like this too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You are...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. So am I, actually.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even though we were in the same group for the Seaside School, all we really did was talk about and work on our performance for the final day.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess so...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. You wanted to talk about Phenny and stuff too, right, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: M-Minori, wait...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. Is it true that you really like Phenny?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, well... I've sort of been wanting to talk to you about the one you have on your bass case, Hinomori...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, this?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, that!
It's a limited Halloween version, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. There were zombies and witches too, but they were mostly gone by the time I got there.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
He's just so popular.
They were all sold out by the time I had a chance to see.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I didn't know that you liked Phenny too, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, I do. My friends and I used to go to PXL pretty often as kids, so the Phenny and the park mean a lot to us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Speaking of which, two of your old friends are in my class.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really?! That means there were only two degrees of separation between you two.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I suppose so.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Her other friend is even in the Cleanup Committee with me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sure, we all go to the same school, but these dots just sort of seem to connect themselves, you know?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (My network of friends is expanding so fast all of the sudden.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I never thought that I'd become friends with celebrities other than my sister.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (This might even give me a chance to ask them what it's like being pros and what we can do as a band.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They're standing where we want to go, so I'm sure there's a lot we can learn from them.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii, would you like more dango?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, just give me one second!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But for now, I should probably just enjoy this party and enjoy being with Shizuku.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's nice to do something like this for a change...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Here you are, Shii! I brought you some sesame paste ones! Would you like me to feed them to you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No thanks. I can handle that part.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But...! There's no need to feel embarrassed or anything, you know?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We get that you want to pamper her, Shizuku, but you have to understand that she isn't a baby.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I understand!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, Shizuku...
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Ichika's been having so much trouble with writing lyrics for our song...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're the one writing these, so I don't see any problems with you doing that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure, that may be true but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I think I like these lyrics more, you know?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too. However, if you're still not satisfied with what you have, you may yet find a better way to express what you're trying to say.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Again, I'm so sorry...
I'll keep trying.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But there's no such thing as a right answer when it comes to these things, so there isn't much we can do.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Still, I should probably try to learn more about songwriting...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hmm...
I doubt this place carries any books like that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm guessing I have to find a bigger bookstore with a special music section...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That one on the other side of the station might work. I think I'll go take a look.)
Oh, Shiho, I thought it was you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hi, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
This is a nice surprise.
Are you out shopping?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I'm still stuck with my lyrics, so I was thinking about clearing my head by going to a cafe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I'm looking for a new place to go since the cafe I was hoping to go to is too crowded.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She's still stuck...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm... I'm so sorry that I'm taking so long. I'm the one that volunteered to write them and...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She read my reaction...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, it's okay. It's our first original song, so I know it's going to take some time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was wondering how I could help. You know, by coming up with certain words or phrases...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Shiho...
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, actually.
Can I ask you a question?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure, what's up?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I've been trying to expand my vocabulary by reading novels, poems and lyrics by other popular artists...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But do you know if there are other ways to go about that?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, I was going to say something about working out a theme or narrative, but you're already doing that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. I still don't feel great about it, but I'm trying.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And seeing what others have written, they just seem worlds different from what I have...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, the learning curve is pretty steep.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Those that can clearly imagine what they're after probably have a much easier time...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Clearly imagine what I'm after...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Such as seeing things from a protagonist's perspective? In this case, Saki, maybe...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, that might work.
I think that's a good way to look at it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Especially if they're a real person.
That may simplify things quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay! Thanks, Shiho.
Your hint might be just what I was looking for!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I promise to finish writing these soon, so please, just give me a little more time!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (First Saki, now Ichika...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Seeing you work so hard is great and all, but don't overdo it, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You can call or text me whenever you're in trouble. Promise that you'll do that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, of course...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, see you at practice tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She should be just fine...
Live House

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Great work today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Geez, I'm still shaking...!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My heart's still pounding too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Same...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That reminds me of the first time I was asked to sub in for someone on bass...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The second I went backstage, that same tidal wave of emotions and exhaustion hit me all at once...)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Hey, there you are. Great show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I-Iori?!
A-And the bassist from STANDOUT...?

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line:
Yes, my name is Mio.
I apologize for not introducing myself sooner.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Especially to you, Hinomori. I've been meaning to thank you since you did so much for us... For me...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: So thank you. I really appreciate what you did then.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? No, you don't have to thank me...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Yes, I do. Iori even mentioned how I need to set things straight.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Anyway, that's that.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Let's get to why we're here.
We saw you girls perform just now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! You did?!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah. I really wanted to see how your original song turned out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, what did you think?

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line:
You did really well.
I can't believe that this is only your second show.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: It's even harder to believe that this is your band's very first song. It was put together so well...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Hang on, was the first song ever I wrote really that bad?

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line:
Huh?!
N-No, that's not what I'm saying...!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Oh, Mio...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Anyway, about how your show went.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, please tell us what you thought!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Like Mio said, you did great considering this is your first show on your own.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I could tell that you gave it absolutely everything you had and even made sure that the crowd would enjoy themselves.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: And your song at the end showed everyone what Leo/need is all about.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's because of the advice you gave me, Iori. Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Don't mention it. It just piqued my interest is all.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: However, you almost lost the crowd just as you transitioned into your original song, so that's something you'll need to work on in the future.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Especially when it comes to a “battle of the bands” show like this since it might affect how the others are able to vibe.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: You losing the crowd means that whoever comes after you has to somehow get them hyped up all over again.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: But Iori, nobody knows who they are yet, so at least for this song...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: That doesn't mean you're allowed to ruin a show for everyone else.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She's right.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Even if we're playing a brand-new song, we have to find a way to reach the audience as we perform.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I thought we practiced that enough, but we're still nowhere near where we need to be...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're right. I do feel bad about what happened and how we didn't do the other band many favors...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we'll make sure that doesn't happen the next time we play... We're not giving up just yet...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll talk about what went well and what didn't. Then, we'll fix those things by practicing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So that we'll be able to touch everyone's hearts next time...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
Next time, we'll give everyone two shows worth of fun!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right! We can't let something like this get us down!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Anyway, I said what I needed to say, so if you'll excuse us.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: We're leaving already?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Well, yeah. We talked plenty, didn't we? Plus, we still have business to attend to.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line:
R-Right...!
We should hurry over to that crepe shop you really like before they close.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Crepe shop?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
M-Mio!
They don't need to know that!

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: S-Sorry!

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line:
Now, if you'll excuse us.
We hope you'll come see our next show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, we'll try, and thank you for coming today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, we're gonna keep giving this everything we've got!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You're all better now?
I thought you were a nervous wreck?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Today was a big first step for us. For Leo/need.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But Saki's right. Let's keep trying our best...

rows.Speaker: Saki, Honami & Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, hey, let's do our little huddle again♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Fine...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Take it away, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's fix our mistakes from today and make our next show even better!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So that we'll go pro as a band someday...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ready?!

rows.Speaker: Saki, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Halfway there with the tickets...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But there isn't much time left until our show, so I need to hurry.)
Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, who else do I know that might be willing to come see our show...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Let's see...
For now, I can scroll through my contacts list...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Morning, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, Minori, Kohane.
Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They might be willing to see our show.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But if I tell them, they might tell Ichika and the others about us having to sell tickets.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'd really rather not ask anyone at school about this...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (So I'll ask them if I really start running out of options.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Leo/need's doing another show soon, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Do you know when?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've really been hoping to see your next show. I couldn't go to the last one since we were busy doing a stream.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I got to hear Saki and Honami play when we were at the Seaside School, so I have to think you sound really amazing when you're all together as a band.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But that's not the best part, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If you go and see Leo/need, you'll get to hear the original song they made!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really?!
You wrote your own music?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, um, Saki came up with the melody and Ichika wrote the lyrics. We're actually working on our second song right now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That's so cool...
Your very own music!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
See what I mean?!
Don't you wanna go see them play?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm such an idiot...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They were right under my nose this whole time...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We do have a date for our next show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?! When?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
One second.
It's written on each ticket.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Here...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you, Shiho!
Whoa! It's a real ticket for a real show!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're that excited about it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I mean, it's really a ticket for a show, right? I'm getting excited by just looking at it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And it looks so different from the tickets you get for idol concerts, so it's double the fun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. It is a nice design. It's clear that you're going to a rock concert.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's see. Your show's scheduled for...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh no, I have an event that day...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm so sorry, Shiho. My team and I are supposed to be in an event that day...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...
I guess there's nothing you can do about that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Nooooo!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: M-Minori?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wh-What's wrong?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
We're doing a stream...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku even said that we should go see your band and cheer for you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Why?! How did this happen?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Alright, alright.
I appreciate the thought, so just try to relax.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I really wanted to go...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks, you two.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We plan on doing more shows in the future, so I'll let you know then.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, really.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Shiho.
It's sad that I can't go this time, but I'm really looking forward to seeing you guys play...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too! We're absolutely 100% gonna go see your next show! We wouldn't be your friends otherwise!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks. I'll be waiting.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Thanks, you two. Thank you so much...)
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho... Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: M-Morning.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, what should we do...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right, well...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is something going on...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Uh, well...
We just heard this rumor about you, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What rumor?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So...
We heard that you and Homani had a fight...

rows.Speaker: Shiho

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Ichika

rows.Speaker: Rin
