rows.Line: Shiho seems very happy.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I'm so glad for her.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Everyone! It's time for Super Sour Russian Roulette! Take your pick☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: C'mon, Shiho, you pick one too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, okay.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Excuse me. You're An Shiraishi, right...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wah?! Y-You scared me...
Yes, I am... Wait, you're...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
My name is Shiho Hinomori.
I'm Kohane Azusawa's classmate.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Would you mind if we talked for a bit?
Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What?!
That wolf's actually Kohane...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, and I apologize on her behalf for scaring you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
N-No, you don't need to apologize!
It's my fault for panicking the way I did!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I feel so stupid. She was just trying to tell me that it was all a big mistake...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was under the impression that their haunted house involved chasing people around the entire school...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We can't really hog the school to ourselves...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
R-Right...!
That's not really possible, huh...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Hang on. What if...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Um, Shiraishi?
Are monsters, like zombies and stuff, sort of not your thing?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: H-Huh?! Wh-What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I can handle those much better than ghosts...
But... I-It's just... I have to prepare myself mentally for those kinds of things, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(I guess that's a yes...
She might be on par with Saki and Honami...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I feel awful for Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We promised to meet up today, and to check out the haunted house together.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Even after telling us every day about how great the preparations for it were going... She sounded like she was having so much fun...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Yeah, she did seem to have a lot of fun with this...and she worked really hard.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I actually went camping a little while ago, so we might be able to use the photos I took then.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They should be on my phone... Oh, here they are! How about the one I took of the forest at night?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She actively came up with ideas, taught everyone on the promo team what she knew and did whatever else she could for them...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She obviously wanted our class' haunted house to succeed. But above all else...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She probably wanted Shiraishi here to genuinely enjoy it.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
But I ran from her... Not only that, I caused trouble for a lot of other people and made you guys look for me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane must be feeling so sad right now...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If this keeps up and you don't get to actually have fun, Kohane's probably going to feel really disappointed.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In herself mostly.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What...?
Not me...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, Kohane's not that kind of person. I'm sure you know that pretty well, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
The School Festival isn't over yet.
You still have time to enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, we're at fault for the wolf's head having a wardrobe malfunction and scaring you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm sure Kohane feels the same way.
So, please try to talk to her when you do meet up.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I promise to bring her here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay...
Thank you, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're such a cool person. Hinomori...
Kohane's actually told me all about you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Kohane's told you about me...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, more than a few times.
She really likes how you're really strong with an unbending personality.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, um...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If you do find her, can you tell her that I'm sorry for running?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I promise to wait here like you said until she's able to make her way here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, I'm gonna go look for her now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be waiting!
Just before the Leo/need show
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Night Festival

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Shiho, look!
This crowd looks huge!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Duh. The whole school's literally here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I am getting a little nervous since we'll be playing in front of more people than usual.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, but the strange thing is, we all have a lot of friends in the audience.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It doesn't matter who's gonna be watching.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Our job is to go on stage and blow them away with our performance. Period.

rows.Speaker: School Festival Committee Member
rows.Line: Leo/need, you're up! Take the stage!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, everyone.
Let's use our performance to turn this into the best night festival ever!

rows.Speaker: Honami, Saki & Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hello! We're Leo/need!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ready everyone?!
One, two...!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Class 1-B Students
rows.Line:
Honami!
Honami!!!
Mochizuki!!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Hehe. Thank you all.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Now it's our turn.

rows.Speaker: Class 1-C Students
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Haruka & Class 1-C Students
rows.Line:
Hoshino! Tenma!
Ichika!
Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh wow...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks, everyone!
We'll do our best!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, this means...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, we fell behind!
Ready Class 1-A?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Class 1-A Students
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Kohane & the Others
rows.Line:
Shiho!
Hinomori!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shiiihhh!!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh geez... Even Sh-Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Classmate
rows.Line: Hey, I didn't know anyone at school outside of the light music club was in a band!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I heard that they even write their own songs.
I'm very much looking forward to their show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you for all your amazing cheers!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Today, we'd like to show you what Leo/need is about by playing some original songs for you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, we hope you enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
Wh-Whoa...!
They're good! Way better than I was expecting!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: I heard from a concertgoing friend that they've been playing at a bunch of different live houses and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
Really?!
That's so cool...!

rows.Speaker: Class 1-C Students
rows.Line: I knew that Ichika and her friends were in a band, but I didn't realize they were this good...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. They're still just getting started.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Huh...?! I'm getting goosebumps!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
M-Me too...!
Their singing! These lyrics! I can't stop listening...!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: They sound so much better than when we went to see them play that one time!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah...! We gotta go see another one of their shows!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I really wanna sing with them now.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh, what if we clapped along?

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do that!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Classmate
rows.Line:
Hey, some girls are clapping along!
Mafuyu, we should clap too!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, if that's what you want.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We decided to play here after Saki kept saying that it's gonna be so memorable and how it's the “definition of enjoying our youth”, but...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Woohoo! Are you ready for the next song, everyone?! Let's keep this energy going!

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Minori & Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shiiihhh!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(This moment isn't just for us.
It's going to be memorable for everybody here.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Ichika, Saki, Honami!
We can do better! Follow my lead!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki & Honami
rows.Line: Okay!
After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, check this out!
The snow feels all crunchy!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Be careful not to slip and fall, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll be fine♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Is she really going to be?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. She's just so happy that it snowed so much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even though her nose always turns bright red when it gets this cold.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (There's something by the side of the path.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, that's a rabbit...made of snow?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Shiho, what are you looking at?
Hey, it's a snow rabbit!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The way it's sitting is so cute.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Now that you mention it, I saw a couple of snowmen in the courtyard.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, me too! Whoever made them must've been celebrating how it snowed so much!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Possibly. Still, it's rare for someone to make a snow rabbit instead of a snowman.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: True.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(This really takes me back...
I remember making these with Shizuku when we were little.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Even if it snowed just a little bit, we'd gather up as much as we could...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And sometimes paint some little pebbles red in place of the red berries we usually used.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But they always melted away by the time we came home from school, and Shizuku would do her best to cheer me up...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, there's only one here.
And it's in kind of a dark corner. Doesn't it seem lonely?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I have a feeling that it's there to keep it from melting.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, it does seem pretty lonely being all by itself...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I thought so!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They say that loneliness can be fatal for a rabbit, so let's make some friends for it to hang out with!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That sounds fun. I'd like to make one as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Me too...
Especially since there's plenty of snow to go around.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Shiho, let's make some together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ngh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, fine...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm...
I can't get mine to look like a real rabbit.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Try rounding your ball of snow into more of an oval. Then, flatten the bottom.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I'll try that...

rows.Speaker: Honami, Saki & Ichika
rows.Line: Finished!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They shrank a little after we trimmed them to make them look nice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, so why don't we just call them baby rabbits?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's place them around the big one and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Cool! They're all together now!
Now it's definitely not gonna feel lonely♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: By the way, what you said about loneliness being bad for rabbits isn't actually true.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I saw something about that once on TV. I guess they were right...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. They tend to share nests together, but prefer to be alone when they go out and about.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
W-Wow, I had no idea...
Where did you learn that, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
The pet simulator app I play with sometimes.
It popped up one day as a little tidbit.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, but!
They don't not like hanging out together, right?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wah...! Th-They're social creatures, so I'm sure they enjoy each other's company.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank goodness! I wasn't sure what I was gonna do if you said they didn't.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Either way, I doubt that you would've just let it be.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You seem happy, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? I do?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's go home.
You guys all had your fun, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Shizuku, quit it...
I can't walk if you glue yourself to me like that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sorry, but I'm just happy about us going to school together since it's been so long.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Practice for this morning got canceled because of the snow, right? That doesn't mean we have to...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, we go home at different times, so mornings are the only chance we get to do this!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Okay, I get it. Just don't get so excited that you trip over something, alright?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, I heard that you slipped and broke your umbrella the other day...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Don't worry. I didn't bring one today!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, that isn't what I meant...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, Shizuku, my class is this way...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Shii, wait.
There's something I'd like to show you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Show me?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes! Look over there!
See that corner that's slightly darkened?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Huh? Isn't that where...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Look, Shii!
It's a nest of cute little snow rabbits!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I knew it...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Remember how we used to make these when we were little after it snowed? Even when there was only some on the ground, we worked so hard to gather up as much as we could!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, I remember...
But I already knew about these...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: One, two, three, four, five...six, seven, eight...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Th-There's more now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, did you already know about them?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I was actually the one who made the first snow rabbit.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, when I returned, there were five. Airi and the others saw that and decided to make their own♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
S-Slow down!
Shizuku, you made the first one?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I did.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It was so nice to see it surrounded by so many friends. I couldn't be happier for it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Do you think someone else made these ones because they didn't want mine to feel lonely?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Actually, Saki, Ichika and Honami made those... And this one's mine...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What...? R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Saki said how rabbits don't like to be lonely, so we decided to make some together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
So, I knew that there were five.
Which is why I was surprised when I saw that there were eight.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (If Momoi made one, then it probably means Minori and Kiritani made the other two.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This is so wonderful! You all saw my rabbit and decided to make some friends for it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm just as surprised as you are.
I honestly wasn't expecting to hear that you made this, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, do you think more will gather?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Who knows? They'll probably melt before that happens since it's supposed to be sunny for a while.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
True.
If only they could stay like this forever...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Isn't it sad, Shii?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I get it. Again, personal space.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is the opposite of when we were little. You always had to cheer me up back then.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In that case, would you mind cheering me up?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
What do you mean, “In that case”...?
No, I'm not going to.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's unfortunate...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
It's cold, so let's head inside already.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. It'd be awful if we both caught a cold.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, you're making it really hard to walk...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? This makes me feel all warm and fuzzy inside.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, you...
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Phew... So glad that I was able to wrap up my classroom duties faster than I expected.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Let's see, Ichika and the others should be in one of these rooms...
I think it's that one.

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line:
Ooh!
So you guys came up with a plan to celebrate♪

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: Yup! It's called “Home Sweet Surprise! From Bedroom to Birthday Party!”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, you girls will be taking Shiho out for the day, and during that time her sister and your other friends will decorate the room?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Shiho's sister and I had a Cleanup Committee meeting today, so I talked to her about the surprise then.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There's still plenty of time until the big day. Plus, Shiho's sister got all excited thinking about picking cute decorations just for her.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Well, we know just how much Shiho's older sister loves her. I'm sure it'll turn out wonderfully.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I can only imagine how surprised she will be when she returns home to find her room transformed into a birthday party.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think so too. And there are also some other things we'd like to do...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Hang on, they're talking about my birthday party...aren't they?
I really shouldn't be eavesdropping on this...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm? Hey Shiho. What are you doing—

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Shhh!
Let's all go in here for a second...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ohh... So you heard about the surprise birthday party, huh? That makes things awkward...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
What should I do?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... I guess all you really can do is pretend you didn't hear anything.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Or you could just be honest, tell them that you overheard their plan, and ask them to change it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Isn't that a little too blunt?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The silver lining is that you only heard about the decorations.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Since it is Ichika and the others we're talking about here, they probably have other stuff in the works for you. They might actually surprise you in the end, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I hope you're right...
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I ended up keeping the eavesdropping incident to myself, but...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I don't know if I'll be genuinely surprised on the day of.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hey, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You look like something's really been on your mind since this morning. Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What? Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's nothing major, so don't worry about it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But...something did happen, right? Did you fall out with Ichika and the others?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, nothing happened with them...
Actually, something did.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It really isn't anything to be that concerned about, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, I suppose it'd be nice to get some advice. Just please don't tell Ichika and the others.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I see...
So you overheard their plans for your birthday surprise.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no. Sounds like you're in a bit of a pickle.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, kind of. But I have a feeling the others will struggle to contain themselves as we get closer to my birthday.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So I might've caught on even if I hadn't overheard.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Either way, I think my only option is to act as natural as possible and hope that they succeed in actually surprising me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But it is a shame that I won't be able to give them the genuine reaction of surprise that they deserve...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shiho! I have an idea on what you can do.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You do?
A few days later
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I was a little surprised when Kohane proposed her idea, but I have to admit, it was a good one.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You feel bad knowing about the surprise Ichika and the others were planning before it happened, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: In that case, why not give them a gift as a token of appreciation for doing all of that?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A gift?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I thought that maybe if you give something to them too, you'll feel a little better.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (A gift... Hope I can find a good one.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now that I think about it, where are Kohane and Minori? Pretty sure we agreed to meet here...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: C'mon Kohane! If we don't hurry, the others will see her!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I'm coming! Oh, there's Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey you two, over here. Also, what's with the rush—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shiho! You need to hide!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, we can hide behind that store! Shiho, quick, this way!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: W-What's going on?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (So that's what Ichika and the others meant by “having plans in the afternoon.”)

rows.Speaker: Minori

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Just promise me you'll play well, okay?
I won't accept anything short of that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We shall! You can count on us, Miss Sunshine!

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Honami
rows.Line: Hehe.
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I can't sleep...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Ugh... When I'm in a different place than I'm used to, I just can't quite relax.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The others are...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Already asleep, I guess.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I don't think I'll be able to fall asleep, so I'll go get some water or...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mhm...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh... Sorry, Saki, I didn't mean to—

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...? It's pitch black...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we were all chatting until just now...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That was already a while ago.
You fell asleep on us, so everyone's sleeping now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! When did I fall asleep?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shhh... Keep your voice down.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh... Sorry.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, did I manage to fall asleep while chatting like it said on my list?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. We were all talking, and then before we knew it you were asleep.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Great...!
Still, I wanted to talk to you guys more...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you want to talk, we can do that tomorrow. Let's just sleep for today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Oookaaay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, you still awake...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Yeah, I'm awake.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Good...
I thought you'd fallen asleep already.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Am I not allowed to?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whaaat, if you fall asleep first I'll be lonely... Don't leave me all alone...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then do your best to fall asleep faster than I do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm awake, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe, sorry, sorry♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I always wanted to do the “you still awake?” thing...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What, why?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean... It's the classic thing you do on school trips or anytime you stay the night as a group, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Right. Saki didn't get to go on the school trip in junior high...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks for doing this sleepover with me, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And for the pictures you surprised me with too! That made me sooo happy!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You already told me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, I can't say it enough!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, alright. If you liked them that much, then I guess it was worth the effort of sneaking those pictures.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I think we're all happy too... Me, Ichika, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Because...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That list of things you wanted to do... Those were all things you couldn't do when you were in the hospital, and had to wait for. So...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, you being able to do all the things you wanted to makes us all—

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait... Are you asleep?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mm... No, I'm...awake...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You were totally asleep just now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mmm...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We're all so happy that you were able to achieve the things you wanted to do.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (When your album is finished, that'll be the last item on your list done...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Once that happens... It might be nice to celebrate somehow...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Yawn*

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'll see what Ichika and the others think tomorrow...)
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay.
This should do it for the certificate's design.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Once Ichika and the others get back from their shopping run, we can start drawing it up.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope Saki likes it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me too!
Thank you all for helping us with this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It's no big deal.
We're also happy about Saki finishing her list of things she wanted to do, so we want to be part of the celebration.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
We're baaack♪
We got all that stuff you asked us to buy!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ichika's the one who actually got it all, though.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Welcome back, everyone!
Do we have everything we need?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I think so.
Can you double check, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sure.
Scissors, pens, some origami paper... Yeah, we're good. We can get this thing made anytime now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Woohoo! Let's make it now☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Is the design all finished?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. What we've got drawn here is how it should look when it's finished.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see... The border is made up of stars. It looks great!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally☆
It's like a starry sky, and so cute!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm glad to hear that...!
To make the real one, we'd like everyone to fold little origami stars and stick them to the “X” markers here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, you even added markers for us.
There are also a bunch of lines drawn both vertically and horizontally...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Those lines are a guide for when we're writing the text.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Shiho measured them all out so carefully before drawing them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean... It'd be pretty lame if the lettering was crooked.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh... Wait, the front looks like it's gonna turn out super cute, but aren't you going to put anything on the back?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Good point... As it stands, this'll probably feel a bit unbalanced.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Then how about drawing some pictures?
Things that Saki likes and stuff.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If we're doing that, we should draw some of the memories we have of us hanging out and such.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay, then let's each draw one picture!
I'm gonna draw a synth♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How about you, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? I...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I guess I'll draw a tennis racket and ball.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Good idea. Saki seemed to enjoy her club activities this year too, so I'm sure that'll make her happy!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, we can take turns drawing pictures on the back... And whoever isn't drawing can work on the origami stars?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sounds good!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The starry border is done☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The back is looking pretty fun as well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh?
What's this scraggly white thing in the corner...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh... That's the ghost I drew.
I remembered going into the haunted house with her during our visit to PXL...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That must be a pretty legit haunted house. This ghost's got blood dripping from its head.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, th-that's not blood, it's, umm...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I thought a cute ghost would make Saki happier, so I tried giving it a ribbon.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh... If you look close, the ghost is smiling.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm kinda starting to find it cute now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
These Phennys next to it are cute too.
They're all different colors like the plushies we have, and they're all lined up next to each other.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, Shiho drew those.
She kept redoing them over and over while comparing them to the plushies here...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, now we just need to write our celebratory message, and it'll be finished.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Have you already decided on the text?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Not yet.
I want us all to give our ideas and decide together...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? It's a message from Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... She said she's working on her album right now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
She sure is.
She said “Look at these pictures I found!” and now there's a bunch of photos coming in.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha, the notifications sure aren't stopping.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Guess she's having fun working on her album.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, what kinds of pictures is she sending?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well... Oh, there are some from the time we had a flower viewing here in SEKAI. Here, there's a picture of when we were all drawing cherry blossoms on the blackboard.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're right! I'm there too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: This is when you and Saki were competing to see who could draw more.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That was so fun.
After we finished drawing, we ate dango and cherry blossom rice cakes together...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It was.
These are the kinds of memories I want to keep making.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, why don't you write about that feeling in the certificate?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That sounds good.
Even when she's finished with her list, we're still going to keep doing stuff together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...! I agree.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then for the certificate, let's write something like, “Congratulations on completing your list. Let's continue to make more memories together.”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sounds good. For the specific wording...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Just a little bit longer until it's finished...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'll do my best to make sure our feelings come through to Saki.)

rows.Line: Good morn...

rows.Speaker: Saki

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I'm gonna do my best to make each day wonderhoy for everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, that's so great!
Good luck! I'll be rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Emu

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's still morning. What are you two shouting about...?

rows.Line:
Oh, Shiho!
Good wonderhoy!!!

rows.Line:
Shiho, guess what?!
You gotta, gotta, gotta hear this!

rows.Line: Emu said she's gonna try to become the class rep!

rows.Line: The class representative?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Now I see...
That explains why you were being so loud just now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, Shiho, aren't you surprised?!
I never would've saw this coming!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, I am surprised.
But...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think you'd do a good job, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You do?!

rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, you're always willing to help out others and know when to act.

rows.Line: On the other hand, our class may be in for a bit of a wild ride.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
That means our class is gonna be super duper fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yippee! Woohoo!
Compliments from Shiho and Saki!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I promise to do my very best!
So, feel free to ask me about anything when it comes to our school!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Slow down. You still haven't officially been chosen to become our class representative...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, you might have some competition.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I promise to campaign for you if that happens! So, good luck!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks, Saki!

rows.Line: While we're on the subject, Shiho, do you know what committee you're gonna be on?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I hadn't given it much thought since we don't necessarily have to join one...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Kohane, Minori and I...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Isn't this...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's the rabbit cage.
Minori and I are supposed to clean it today...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But you said the other day that you like bunnies, so we wanted you to see!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We need to move them out of their cage and into the next room before we can get started...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, Shiho, would you like to help us carry them?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I... I'm not a member of the animal caretaker committee.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, if you need help cleaning...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I actually kinda enjoyed that...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What's this?
The look on your face says you're interested in joining one.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
...
I dunno what you're talking about.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wait, there is?!
Tell us! Tell us! Which committee do you wanna be on, Shiho☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, the thing is, I had a few chances to help the animal caretaker committee last year...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
And...
Well, it's not like I'm completely uninterested in joining...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
The animal caretake committee!!!
That makes sense since you love animals so much, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: N-No, you're getting the wrong idea.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Also...
I probably wouldn't be able to contribute much because of work and band practice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, I'm in the same situation as you, but I still plan on joining a committee!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I bet you'd love being on the animal caretaker committee! You should totally join if you're that interested!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
She's right!
I say go for it if you wanna join!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I know you're busy, and life happens...
But I'm sure everyone else on the committee will lend you a hand if you ask for help.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I've even participated in tournaments for a lot of different clubs after they asked for my help.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
A lot of the clubs ask for your help because you're so athletic!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's true that I could ask the other committee members for help if I ever think I need it...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Still, if I'm going to join, I want to fully commit to it and contribute however I can.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Plus, these two are saying that I should...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, I'll give it a try...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's great!
I'm sure the bunnies are gonna love having you take care of them☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, and I'm sure you'll give them all the love they'll ever need!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I get it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I am looking forward to taking care of them...)

rows.Line: Shiiiho!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Anyway, what's up?

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Saki

Oh, you're buying lunch today?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, Emu, your lunch box is as big as always!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I'm still amazed by how you can eat all this food.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I need to eat a lot to do my best during afternoon classes☆

rows.Line: Oh, Saki, your Salisbury steaks look like stars! And it's so cute how the sauce sparkles!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. My mom made these for me!
The ones she makes are really juicy and delicious!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
They look really yummy!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Then, I'll share some with you.
I really want you to taste them for yourself!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! Then, Saki, you can have anything you want from my lunch!

rows.Line: Cool! Let's trade!

rows.Line: Shiho, how about...? Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What is it...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You're drinking milk...?
But you always get tea.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:

You felt like... Wait, milk...

rows.Line: Is your height bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Lemme guess. You were thinking about your measurement results just now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, you're wrong.

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Yeah, Kamishiro is pretty tall even for a boy his age.)

rows.Line: (Girls don't grow the same way as boys, but it might be worth asking what he eats on a regular basis...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh? Fine, be that way.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I'll still let you have some of my Salisbury steaks. So that you grow big and strong♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Seriously, I'm not that bothered by my height or anything...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But I might buy some milk on my way home and try to go to bed early tonight.)

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, Shiho, it feels like it's been forever since the last time the two of us had lunch together like this...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right.
You've been busy during lunch lately working on that song.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I figured you and Ichika would eat together, but I guess you guys missed lunch a couple times.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, we did!
It was so hard to stay focused during afternoon classes when that happened.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, Saki, while we're on the subject.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you for writing that song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Why are you thanking me?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I felt that I needed to express it properly.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Especially after seeing you and Ichika doing your best at school and during practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, you two came up with an amazing song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
Hehe. That makes me really happy!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Plus, this song seemed to give you two some trouble. I mean, you and Ichika sorta got into a fight over it, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, yeah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I honestly didn't know what to do when that happened.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And what I said to her...
I feel like it was really hurtful...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. Ichi and I couldn't agree on what we wanted to do. I started to feel really frustrated about how she wasn't understanding how I felt.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which put me in a sour mood...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I think you two fighting isn't necessarily a bad thing...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're both serious about what you're doing, so it's only natural to bump heads sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I get that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I was so sure that Ichi and I wouldn't run into any problems...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even if we disagreed about something, I thought we'd be able to figure things out. But it just didn't go that smoothly...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I couldn't help but start wondering why she couldn't see what I was going for...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And the opposite is also true.
I had trouble understanding what Ichi wanted to do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was so obsessed with getting her to understand what I wanted from our song.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think what you two did is really cool.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, you both had messages that you wanted to get across.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even if it meant fighting with each other, neither of you were willing to bend on that, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't see anything wrong with being adamant about how our song should turn out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sure Mr. Shindo liked what he heard because you were so set on what you wanted to make.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, you really produced something amazing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, what you two experienced was probably a bit painful...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But knowing that you two put everything into that song makes me want to play it all the more.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They wrote the best song they possibly could.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Now I need to play it in a way that does it justice...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That's my job moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We need to practice playing our debut song like there's no tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!
Shiho's Room

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A message from Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “I just got home from work and started watching 'Walking with Minori.' This is totally you and Hona talking, right?!”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We were never on camera, but I guess it's hard not to recognize our voices...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: “We just happened to be nearby and decided to lend a hand.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Whoa, she replied right back...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “No fair! I totally would've gone if I wasn't scheduled to work! I could've been on her stream!”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, geez.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line: Shii, do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Sure, come in.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Welcome back. I didn't realize you were home.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I just got back.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sorry, I know this is sudden, but I was hoping we could talk about what happened during Minori's stream today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh...
Should I not have joined in?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, that's not what I'm here to say.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I wanted to thank you for helping her, Shii.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, we are friends.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Also, how did you know I was there?
Didn't you say that you'd be working all day?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was able to watch a bit of the stream, on break and in transit. I haven't seen the whole thing yet...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But after finishing up with work at one place, I decided to tune in, and I was so startled to hear your voice!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I knew that you and Honami would be going together, but I had no idea that Kusanagi and Ena would also be there.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, we were also surprised.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Kusanagi was there to help with the show, and Shinonome said she was working on an assignment for art class.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I had no idea!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, Shizuku, if you saw, then does that mean Momoi and Kiritani did as well?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it seems that way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's important for us to communicate as a team at times like this. So, the second I realized that it was you, Shii, I sent them a message.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “Incredible news! Shii's joined Minori on her walk! I hope you all get a chance to watch♪”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Communicate as a team...?
Sounds more like you just wanted them to watch.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because I did.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, anyway, how did they react?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They were just as surprised as I was.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Actually, we became a little worried about people thinking it was staged since so many of her friends suddenly appeared all at once.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Fortunately, our worries were misplaced.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I kept a close eye on the comments, and none of the viewers made any undue accusations, at least while I was watching.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure everyone knows Minori would never do something like that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, they all seemed to really enjoy our conversation...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I have a feeling that everyone watching wants you, Minori and the others to succeed from the bottom of their hearts.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, if that's true, then we couldn't be happier.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: By the way, Shii...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori and Kusanagi both got to wear those beautiful dresses. Did you also try one on?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? I...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, stop! Don't tell me yet!
I need time to prepare myself mentally!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I was just trying to say...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know! Why don't you start by telling me what you saw!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They had quite a few different exhibits, yes? What did you see? Which did you think was the most fun? Oh, did you visit the interactive corner?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, personal space!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honestly...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Hang on. Is this why she came to my room? Did she just want to talk about this...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Um, Shii...?
Is this enough space? Can you tell me what you saw now?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Well, that's my sister for you...)
Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's eat...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I like how we all brought lunches today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Me too!
Also, Ichi, the Salisbury steak in yours is huge!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We had them for dinner last night, so this is sort of just how it turned out after my mom gathered up the rest of the meat...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can I have a piece? I'll give you some of my fried chicken in return.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, you can tell us after you've finished eating that, but I wanna hear more about the Phoenix Bridal Fair!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That is sort of why we're gathered here today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You went last time, right, Honami?
And you said a lot had changed?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. The biggest difference for me was the booth with all the designer dresses.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They apparently went with completely new designers this time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The staff did mention how their goal is to expose the guests to as many different designers as possible.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, so that means you get to see a new lineup of dresses each time you go!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, did you try any on? Minori wore one during her stream!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, we didn't try any on.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! But you did last time, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That was because I wanted Ms. Yoisaki to have a good time while we were there...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Does that mean you didn't try one on either, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Of course I didn't.
I just decided to tag along after getting some shopping done.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, the primary goal was to check out the planetarium wedding.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, right! That also really caught my attention♪ How was it, Hona?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It was beautiful.
And so romantic.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, the planetarium was put together better than I was expecting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yeah, it was really pretty.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That sounds amazing. Can't we do something like that in SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hmm... We could, since we'd have a starry sky available to us...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I dunno. It's not just the stars, it's about the width of the planetarium and the ceiling height and stuff. I don't think it'd be that simple.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yeah, it'd feel too open on the roof, and the classrooms don't have very high ceilings...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right. That's too bad...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I'm sure they'll be doing it again, so we should all go together the next chance we get.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, I know...
We could make ring bearer boxes together in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ring bearer boxes...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Uhh... That's where the wedding rings and the little pillow go, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Shiho, Ena and I made some together since they can double as fancy accessory holders.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Really?!
Do you have pictures? I'd really like to see what you three made.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay. Mine was... Oh, here it is.
I used a birdcage as the base, and made a necklace stand.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow, this looks storebought...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They had quite a few pictures of examples and a wide assortment of materials available, so the possibilities were endless.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Ena's looked like this...
She used a crown as the base.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, this is also really amazing!
It's so cute and fashionable!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, this design has her name written all over it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, Shiho, where's yours?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Here's mine...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
Th-That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, it's nothing like the ones Honami and Ena made.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I made a little box to display a pick.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I did my best to keep things simple, so the pick takes center stage instead of any decorations.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You were so silent from the moment you started until the moment you finished.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You know I get really focused in those kinds of situations...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. We know.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No fair. It would've been so much fun to go and make these together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's done is done, so there's no point in complaining. For now, have some fried chicken.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And a piece of my Salisbury steak.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Here, you can have some of my potato salad!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, you guys are trying to buy me off with food!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, we aren't.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, we'll just take it all back if you don't want it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No way! Not so fast!
You guys gave it to me, so it's all mine now!!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, they're yours.
Just hurry up and eat them so you start feeling better.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That was good.

rows.Speaker: Ramen Shop Owner
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Phew...
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I knew that place's soy sauce ramen was good, but the pork bone broth was a nice surprise.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They even seem to have miso ramen on the menu, so I might try that after work next time.)
se_walk_women_001_2

Bananas with chocolate again?
But this crepe shop has so many other options...
Yeah, but this is what I like.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Those voices...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Also, you're always getting that cinnamon apple one.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Because that's one of the few that don't come with whipped cream.
se_walk_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Iori, Mio...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Good evening, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Good evening.
Talk about a coincidence. We ran into each other at the live house just the other day.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right.
After acting all cool and saying we'd see you during our next show too.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Are you heading back from work?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes. I was just about to start heading home after stopping by that ramen shop over there for dinner.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: We just wrapped up a meeting at the record company. We're aching for some sugar since we've been thinking about this and that.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
How about a crepe for dessert?
On me, to celebrate your big debut.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Hehe. You're starting to sound like her senior, Iori.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
That's because I am.
We did make our debut before them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: True.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, if you don't mind buying your junior a crepe.

rows.Speaker: Shiho, Mio & Iori
rows.Line: Let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is good...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I know, right?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: This chain's got stores all over, but the one in Shibuya really is the best.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Did you go around and check?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Not exactly.
But I have been able to go to a lot of them...

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I remember you having them basically every day until not too long ago.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Every day?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Hey, you're making it sound like I'm some sort of pig.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: The song we were working on at the time was giving us a lot of trouble. So, I started having these to reduce my stress and get the sugar I needed...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I didn't realize you could hit a wall like that, Iori...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: It happens.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: But that particular song ended up becoming a pain because of our record company's demands.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Until now, you've been able to pursue music the way you want, right? You've decided when to write new songs and put on shows.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
But you can't do that as pros.
In the eyes of record companies, we're their business partners.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're talking about having to work as stipulated in whatever agreements we sign?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: More to the point, you have to constantly think about becoming more profitable.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I was under the impression that STANDOUT has been doing pretty well since they debuted...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But I guess a lot happens behind the music.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Umm... I don't know if this is okay for me to ask, but how did you go about producing this new song you just mentioned...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, that was all thanks to Mio.
She got really mad at me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What? Her? Getting mad at you?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah. She said that I shouldn't write a half-baked song while pouting about what the company told us to do. That if I had a problem, I should channel those feelings into our new song.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: I-I didn't say it like that!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: But that's basically what you said.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I thought I was doing what people wanted from us as pros, but the lyrics I wrote definitely told a different story.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Mio's words opened the floodgates when it came to editing it.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Honestly, she started to really irritate me, but I was also happy about her getting on my case.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Because we were both taking a hard look at our music as members of STANDOUT. As equals.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And I wouldn't expect any less from you guys...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: You jealous?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No...
I can say the same for us.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Hehe. That's what I like to hear.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you for the crepe.
And I really enjoyed our conversation.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: We're both still just getting on our feet as professional bands, but let's keep pushing each other to become better.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Through our music.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, let's. And I hope the next time we meet is on stage.
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Geez, Saki, don't shout right next to me like that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aww, c'mon! I was just giving a hearty greeting!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha. It was pretty hearty.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hearty doesn't mean you have to be obnoxiously loud...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wh-What?!
I was just trying to set things up so that we have a fun practice. But now... I...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'll just have to be even louder!
Wah! Wah! Wah!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Alright, fine, I get it.
I'm sorry.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? What was that?
I couldn't hear you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sorry!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. It's been so long since you last shouted like that, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, this is quite a rare sight.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Alright, anyway...
We need to start getting everything set up for practice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Remind me what song you'll be practicing today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Our debut song.
But it'd be nice to practice some of our other originals if we have time...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Here's your cable, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I saw you and KAITO having a really long practice session together a couple days back.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A couple days back...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're going to get in a solid practice together today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, that day...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I felt like playing my bass a little, so I asked KAITO if he'd practice with me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But he was really into it that day for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Into it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh? Can you elaborate?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: He decided to take the drums in order to make sure I was able to get in a good practice, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I was a fraction of a second late coming in, wasn't I?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right...
Just a fraction, but...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Would you like to try that again...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, please.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That seemed pretty good...
At least, it felt that way while I was drumming.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Shiho...
Can we try playing that song again?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'll be on the keyboard this time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, that'd be nice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's this one part where I feel that Saki and I could play much better, so I'd especially appreciate if we could practice that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, he ended up playing the keyboard for me during our session.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. He must've started having a lot of fun while practicing with you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: He even played the guitar and bass for me after that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, him going on guitar makes sense, but why two basses...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Twin basses!
That sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, it does! I wish you'd told us about your session.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It was pretty late.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you're interested, why don't you go ask KAITO? I'm sure he'll want to do a session with you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I might go ask him after practice today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
In that case, me three.
It'll probably be a good learning experience.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, no fair! Me four! Me four!

rows.Speaker: Miku
