rows.Line: That's right! It makes me happy that you can tell just from looking at it...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah! You found mine!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's amazing, Shiho! How are you finding them so fast?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm pretty sure we all wanted her to find them, which is why we didn't make it too difficult, but even so...she's very fast.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup. Although, Shizuku's might've been too easy.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright. I think the only ones left are from Momoi, Kiritani and Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't think we've made it a walk in the park for you. We definitely put ours in places you would never expect. Right, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sure did! Hope you're prepared, Hinomori!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really? We'll see about that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: After coming this far, I'm not giving up. I'll be sure to keep searching.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright. That'd make this last letter from Kiritani. Which means, mission complete.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Aw... I guess you found it in the end. I sneakily hid it in your bag during the party, but I didn't expect you to figure that one out.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Same here! I was so sure that she would never be able to find yours!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I didn't have any luck anywhere else, so I had a suspicion. I'm glad I was right.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: More importantly...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: These are a lot of letters...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's like a mountain! You were so cool finding them all one after another, Shiho! You were like a detective♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, it was pretty fun actually.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm going to treasure all of these. Thank you for planning all of this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course! All we wanted was to just make sure you smile!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes! But the party has only just started. Hope you have a fun time, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know, I know. I'm looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shii! It really did make me happy when you realized the sweatshirt was from me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know you're working hard as a pro now, but let's go somewhere together again for a break sometime.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shiho. I was so confident that you weren't going to find my letter! But that frustration was gone as soon as I saw your face when reading it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I feel the same way. We could see that you read them all with such care. Thank you for accepting our messages, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shiho! Spending time like this together kind of takes me back to when we were first-years! It was so much fun! Let's go hang out again sometime with Kohane, the three of us!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to go hang out somewhere with you too, Shiho. I know you're busy with being a pro but let's definitely do it sometime. Hope you have an amazing rest of your day!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shiho! I did a lot of thinking of what to write in my letter to you, so I hope it'll be a letter you can read over and over again☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I heard that you took the time to read my letter as well. Do let me know if the speaker's battery runs out, as I'll be sure to swap it with new ones. It came with a lifetime's warranty after all!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Hinomori. Um, my letter is just a regular one, but... I've written down how to turn off the speaker. So please read it when you have the time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Once again, happy birthday, Hinomori! If you ever have some time, do come by Vivid Street again! It'll be so much fun getting to watch a show together!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I heard from Otori about your birthday party. Sounds like you all had a fun time. Happy birthday, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shiho! Saki told us about the plans, so we also wrote letters too. Right, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was wondering what was with the sudden request for an illustration, but when I found out it was a gift for you, I made sure to pull out all the stops. I hope you like it, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shiho. We wanted to see you smiling like you did when you were reading the fan letters, and I guess our plan was a success.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's keep doing our best as Leo/need from here on out. Let's keep improving so more people can come to know us, all so we can reach their hearts with our music.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Looks like our feelings also reached Shiho through our letters. Teehee♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It made me happy that you enjoyed the party♪ Happy birthday again! Let's keep performing and making music together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shiho. It was a little intimidating expressing my feelings through a letter, but I'm glad you liked it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We've got practices, shows and recordings, but let's keep doing our best for all of them! I hope you had an amazing birthday today!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you for all the birthday wishes.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I had a really fun time today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I realized once again just how many people care about me...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To make sure that I return that sentiment...I'll be sure to give my best performance.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, I hope you stick around.
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I bought some juice, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And I brought some snacks☆
Let's have them while making our cards!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks, you two!
We should be all set to make our message cards now♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, now that we're all here, let's get started!

rows.Speaker: Shiho & Emu
rows.Line:
Okay.
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Let's see... Who should I start with?
There's just so many people I need to thank.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I guess it's gotta be Ichi and Hona!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess that'd make the most sense for us. Do you already know who your first card is going to, Otori?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
They're going to Nene, Tsukasa and Rui☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: After I make those, I'm gonna work on the ones for my family♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that was also my plan!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Cards for my family...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I still haven't properly thanked Shizuku for her Valentine's Day gift yet...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Happy Valentine's Day, Shii♪
I hope you enjoy your gift.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks. Huh? This is...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I tried embroidering a picture of your bass into a handkerchief.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wow, this is pretty good...
And really detailed. You even made sure to include the tuning pegs.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(She came up with this design just for me...
And she probably worked really hard on it.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I promise to make good use of it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you. That would make me so happy.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Shizuku put a ton of thought into my Valentine's Day gift...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (So, I think I'll thank her by making her a nice card.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I think I'll write my brothers messages that tilt up to the right♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I get it! Like a line chart going up?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I thought they'd like that, since they're both in management!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see. But striking a nice balance won't be easy. It'll just look sloppy if you don't commit to it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right... In that case, what if you tilted the card slightly?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Saki, that's such a wonderhoy idea!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm... My card keeps moving around...
I can't get this tape on straight.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Here, I'll hold it down for you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Shiho, thank you so much!
Now I can put on all the tape I want!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Try not to tape my hands down too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! I'd never do such a thing!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That should be all of them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Our cards turned out so well☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! When we first started, I really wasn't sure how I should make them...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But so many good ideas began popping into my head while we chatted. Before I knew it, they were all complete!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. And I really appreciate you two helping me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Same. This was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was!
I hope everyone likes what we made.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I know they will!
I mean, we put so much thought into all of them!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, true.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Including me...)
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Have you all had a chance to exchange your cards?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, we're all done.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: My heart's full of so much joy after receiving all these thoughtful cards.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Mine too. Not only were they fun to make, I got to tell you all things that I couldn't normally.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Right.
Thank you for hosting this wonderful event for us, you two!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm really glad you guys enjoyed everything♪
Now I can't wait to give Tsukasa and my parents their cards!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You made some for your family.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Are you gonna give Shizuku her card later?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I was gonna, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean you've changed your mind?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, Shih, you have to give it to her!
I mean, you worked so hard on it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She's for sure gonna blow it way out of proportion, and I'm sort of getting self-conscious about the whole thing.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now I wish I hadn't put her off until last...
A few hours later
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Voice
rows.Line: Can I come in, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hi, Shii...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, please come in.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad that you decided to come over, Shii! How can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Umm... This is for you. I wanted to thank you for Valentine's Day.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, what a wonderful card...!
The stickers of these little birds are so adorable! And these leaves around the border are beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, Shii, did you make this yourself?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah... You embroidered that handkerchief for me for Valentine's Day, so I thought I should also make you something in return.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And I mean, you're always doing things for me, so I figure doing stuff like this isn't so bad, from time to time...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you so much, Shii...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Whoa...! Sh-Shizuku?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to receive such a lovely card. I'm so happy right now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: O-Okay, I get it...! Let go of me already.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
But I promise to cherish this card forever!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's really nothing that special...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. But you made this card just for me. That means it's a true one-of-a-kind.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Anyway, can I read what you wrote?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Sure, I guess...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you! Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
“Dear Shizuku.
Thank you for always keeping me in your thoughts. I know that you lead a really busy life.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Wait, she's gonna read the whole thing out loud...?!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “I really admire how you treat your fans with the utmost respect, and I think it's cool how much you do to exceed their expectations.”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
...!
Shii, you really believe...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can we please get this over with already?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “But please don't forget to take breaks from time to time, for the sake of your own health. I'll always be rooting for you as you strive to become a great idol.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I honestly wasn't expecting her to read my message out loud right in front of me...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (If I'd known she'd do that, I would have just read it out myself.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Shii.
My heart's full of so much joy now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The card is lovely by itself, and then you also wrote me such a sweet message...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I honestly couldn't have asked for a better gift.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay. I'm glad that you like it so much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Telling anyone how I actually feel is still pretty embarrassing for me...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But if she's feeling this happy...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Then maybe I should do this more in the future.)
Music Shop

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's see, the Free Cluster corner should be... Oh, here it is!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The top part is all their CDs, so this must be all their DVDs...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They have so many DVDs of their shows.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We should watch as many of them as we can for our research.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. It's research too, but I also want to see what Free Cluster's shows are like before we open for them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, there's no way we're gonna be able to get through all of these. We need to choose the best ones for us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
In that case... Oh, what about this one?!
It's filmed at the same arena we'll be playing!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's buy that.
It should help us get a good idea of what things are going to be like when we take the stage.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: One of their more recent shows would also be nice. I wanna see what they're like currently.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Their most recent one is... This one?
Oh, it even includes some bonus footage.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There's a video of them rehearsing, and there's also an interview about the show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
A video of them rehearsing...?
That might help us get a good understanding of the arena's acoustics and such.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And the interview should let us hear what they focused on while planning their show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's learn as much as we can about all this stuff together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Still, an interview...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, someday when we release a DVD like this, do you think we'll get to record an interview like them?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, it's pretty standard as far as bonus footage goes...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, if we include an interview as bonus footage for our very first DVD, what would you guys wanna talk about?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Aren't you getting a little ahead of yourself?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?! No, I'm not!
Thinking about this now might help us in the future!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: True, this could help with magazine interviews and such.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Then, I'd probably want to talk about Miku.
She's special to us personally, not to mention an integral part of Leo/need's music.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's very like you, Ichika. I think that's great.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
In my case...
I'd probably want to talk about what makes you all so great.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think anyone going out of their way to watch interviews would be very interested in learning more about us as people.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's a little embarrassing, but it's not a bad idea.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I'll tell everyone all about what an amazing person you are, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you, Saki.
So, what would you discuss during our interview?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me? There's so much I wanna talk about, but I'd probably start by discussing our songs!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because they mean so much to us, and we all invested a ton of time and effort into them!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, and for the interview, how cool would it be to sit in big chairs while wearing sunglasses and stuff like movie stars?♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's probably best to just be ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, you don't get it!
It's important to act like we're a big deal!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, Shiho, what would you talk about during our interview?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll pass.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, you can't do that!
It's your turn to talk now!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. Imagine all the people you'd disappoint by being the only one not to say anything.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not you too, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Fine...
I'd talk about the history of Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The history of Leo/need?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. I'd start with how we got our band back together during our first year of high school, decided to try going pro together, practiced like there was no tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Put on a successful solo show, and actually turned pro. I'd also mention our commercial, our first appearance at a big festival and all the other challenges we've taken on.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: How we got to open for Free Cluster.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't know what's gonna happen moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But when we look back on all this sometime in the future, I feel like this next show is going to be a real turning point for us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It'll be our big chance for us to reach a new level as a band!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Let's do our best to make that happen.
So we can talk about how we faced a massive challenge and came out of it stronger.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: For now, let's start by watching these DVDs!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. We should keep an eye out for things that we can take in for ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll put together a schedule leading up to our lesson with Ms. Naruse. That should make it easier for us to come up with a detailed set of goals.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Let's do everything we can.
First, we need to improve the way we play so that we're able to put on the perfect performance for Ms. Naruse.

rows.Speaker: Honami, Saki & Ichika
rows.Line: Right!
Shiho's Room

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The video file for Leo/need should be... Oh, I think this is it. And play...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Voice
rows.Line: <We're Leo/need! Thank you all for having us!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Okay, the sound's crystal clear.
This should allow me to go over every detail of our performance.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I really need to thank Ms. Naruse again for sending this over.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(The intro went exactly like we practiced.
And Ichika didn't miss a beat with her singing...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But it's pretty clear that we weren't in perfect sync as we transitioned to the second verse.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We might've rushed ahead because we were so excited. I'll need to see how we do during our next practice.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (After the first chorus, Ichika and I have our solos...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Yeah, this is around where the crowd all began waving their hands...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (This was a completely new arrangement, so we weren't exactly sure how they were going to react...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (So I'm glad it went over with them so well.)

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: <Here we go!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Free Cluster did a solo relay too, but the crowd's reaction is on an entirely different level.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (There's the gap in technical skill, but there are other touches, like how the keyboardist kept the beat alongside the drummer. Even the way they made the lights strobe helped raise the excitement...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They really used everything at their disposal to get the crowd going.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (On top of all that, they changed up their relay order totally on the fly.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(I've seen a couple other bands do that...
But it really makes it feel like a unique and special groove you could only get from this particular live performance.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It might be good for us to try something like this in the future.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line: Shii, can I come in?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh... Yeah, sure.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry for bothering you all of a sudden. I made some tea and was wondering if you'd like some... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is this a video of the show you did the other day?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. I was sent a video of it. I was just seeing how we did.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
In that case, Shii...
Would it be alright if I watched it with you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I really wanted to go, but I was scheduled to work that day...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll watch from over here, and I promise not to get in your way. So, please...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, after they announced that we'd be playing, she almost cried after finding out that she wouldn't be able to go...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, you can watch.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? Thank you so much, Shii...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Here, I'll start it over from the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wow...! You all look so cool!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Shii, look!
It's a close-up on you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I know...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You all seem to be playing with much more energy than normal. The audience just looks so excited...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, we made that one of our primary goals.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I see.
Hehe. I'm glad your plan ended up going so well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, to think that you and the others got to play a show at such a large venue...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm just... I'm so happy for you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're blowing things out of proportion again. We were just the opening act.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Don't say that!
The opening act is a very important role.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You've always said you want as many people as possible to hear your music...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's why I'm so happy. You took a big step towards making your dream come true...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right...
Thanks for saying that, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Shii, it's your solo...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
This is incredible...!
You look so cool!

rows.Speaker: Shiho

rows.Line: Huh? Wh-Why would I do that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, even standing on top of a desk, our little friend still has to look up at us, y'know?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was just thinking, it must be really uncomfortable constantly looking up like that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I thought it was weird when she suddenly asked for a handshake...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't need any of your funny ideas...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huuuh? Whatever do you meeean?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Geez...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, Mimitchi, what are you going to do now?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you probably won't be able to go back until it's morning on Tamagotchi Planet and you wake up, right?

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Yup! So, I wanna stay here for a while.

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: And...

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: It'd be great if you could all teach me how to sing!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What? How to sing?

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: I wanna learn to sing that song better for our recital!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, you did say none of your attempts went well...

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: That's why I wanna know how I'm supposed to sing, and how to be in sync with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What do you all think? We're in the middle of our practice, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's help! I mean, Mimitchi came all this way listening to us perform.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd also like it if we could help.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We can practice another time, but this may be our only chance to teach Mimitchi what we know.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, we did do well on that last performance... I guess we could call the rest of our practice off for now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Mimitchi... We'll help you with your singing.

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Thank you! I'm ready to learn!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, let's start Mimitchi's singing practice.

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi & Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We have a feel for the song you're working on now, so should we jump right into singing it?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'd like to hear more about what Mimitchi sees as a hurdle before we get into it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Good point. You mentioned that you were having trouble getting in sync...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But there must be some specific reason you feel that way. For example, you could have trouble keeping in rhythm or maintaining correct pitch.

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Um, I'm hitting the right pitch, I think.

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: But I start having so much fun when I'm singing... Before I know it, I'm singing a different part from everyone else.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sounds like you might be getting ahead of everyone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can understand that. Sometimes it just feels so good that you want to lose yourself in the momentum.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But it's a recital where everyone has to sing together, after all.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why don't you try listening to how everyone sounds and singing to match that, Mimitchi?

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Listen to them while I sing... Got it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, let's give it a shot. Can we get your accompaniment, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay♪ Here we go, everyone!
One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Stop there!
Did you notice your timing getting off there, Mimitchi?

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line:
Ohh, I had too much fun again and went all fast!
I've gotta listen to everyone and match them!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's try again.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, here we go!
One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Listen and match, listen and match...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...? Mimitchi?

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
I forgot to sing! L-Let's do that again, please!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nice. You're at the point now where you can listen to one other person and match them really well.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, now you're so focused on timing that you're not coming in as strong. That's definitely a waste.

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Got it! I'll be careful about that next time!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nice! You've gotten a lot better compared to when we started.

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Thank you! But even though I was finally in sync, now I feel like my pitch was off.

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Let's do that part again!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, hold on. You've been singing nonstop for a while, so you should take a break.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. You wouldn't want to overexert yourself and hurt your throat.

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Hmm, I wanna keep practicing, but... Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Now that you've got some time on your hands, do you want to try playing any instruments?

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: I'd love to!! I wanna see what sounds I can make♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, hey! Let's look at the stars together later too! The sky here is so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone! That was a great chorus.

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Really?! That makes me super happy!

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Shiho, everybody, thank you! I think I'll be able to do a good job with my tama friends now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think you'll be fine too. You were really serious about practicing and all.

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: I just heard Mametchi's voice...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Mametchi is one of your friends, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... I didn't hear anything, though.

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: I heard it again! Mametchi is singing!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Did you hear it, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, nothing at all...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Singing...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Maybe Mametchi realized you got lost in your dream and started looking for you.

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Oh yeah...! Everyone in our group said they'd try the sleep-learning machine!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You mean, your friends might all be in SEKAI too?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If not the others, it at least seems like this Mametchi is.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The assumption is probably that if song is what brought you here, then that's the way to contact you.

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Then, Mametchi's singing to find us?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That would seem to be the case.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If that's true, you've gotta hurry over! I know I'd be worried.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That means we have to say goodbye, though...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: But, I just made such great friends... I don't wanna say goodbye.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know how you feel... I wanted to talk to you some more too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you know you've gotta go put your friend at ease.

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: I'm gonna go to where Mametchi is!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Sing along with your friend, wish for your reunion with all your heart, and SEKAI and your song will guide you.

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: Can I ask everybody for one last thing...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure. Let's hear it.

rows.Speaker: Mimitchi
rows.Line: I wanna sing together one more time!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Got it.
Are you guys in?

rows.Speaker: Saki, Ichika & Honami
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's sing with them, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Gladly! I'll fill this song with my wish for Mimitchi's reunion.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The air around Mimitchi is glowing...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Goodbye, Mimitchi... Do your best at the recital.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Mimitchi's gone...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Do you think we'll ever get to see each other again?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't know. But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even though you only spent a short time together, I could feel a real bond between you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, just maybe...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. SEKAI and the power of your feelings may just give you another opportunity someday.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I don't know when that'll be, but...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'll see you then, Mimitchi.)
